messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11, and the pin lifts when the full reindex completes. [valid 2025-08-27 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-08-27]
- On 2026-03-10, Team Dune observed that the reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2026-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-10-2]
- Farah takes the first on-call rotation for Team Dune. [valid 2025-01-16 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-16]
- As of 2025-11-07, the reporting service belongs to the Ember team, which took it over from Team Dune. [valid 2025-11-17 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-17-reporting-correction]
    earlier: As of 2025-11-07, the reporting service belongs to Team Boreal, which took it over from Team Dune. [valid 2025-11-07 to 2025-11-17; recorded by handover/2025-11-07-reporting]
    earlier: Team Dune owns the reporting service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-11-07; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20-2]
- The reporting service can be released on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception. [constraint; valid 2025-02-25 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-02-25]
- Priya takes the first Atlas pager shift. [valid 2025-01-14 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-14]
- As of 2025-09-15, the reporting service reads from the event bus instead of querying the ledger directly and no longer depends on the ledger. [decision; valid 2025-09-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-15]
    earlier: The reporting service depends on the ledger. [valid 2025-04-08 to 2025-09-15; recorded by standup/dune/2025-04-08]
- Lena takes the first Boreal on-call shift of the year. [valid 2025-01-13 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-13]
- Yuki takes the first Team Cinder on-call shift of the year. [valid 2025-01-14 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-14]
- On 2025-11-07, Farah walked Marcus through the reporting service runbook. [valid 2025-11-07 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-07-reporting]
- On 2026-03-31, the Ember team observed that the feature-flags service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and flagged it because the service is not theirs. [valid 2026-03-31 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-31]
- The reporting service must stay on Python 3.11 until the pandas 3 upgrade lands. [constraint; valid 2025-05-09 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-05-09]
- As of 2025-06-16, dashboards and alerts for the catalog service are being repointed. [valid 2025-06-16 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-16-catalog]
- As of 2025-11-20, dashboards and alerts for the event bus are being repointed. [valid 2025-11-20 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-20-event-bus]
- As of 2026-05-25, Team Atlas has switched to a no-deploy Friday. [decision; valid 2026-05-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-25-2]
- On 2025-07-28, Team Cinder reported that the ledger's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2025-07-28 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-07-28-2]
- There is a deploy freeze on the billing service from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02 because of peak season. [constraint; valid 2025-11-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-04]
- On 2026-02-12, the Ember team reported that the indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2026-02-12 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-02-12]
- There is a deploy freeze on the ledger from 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 because of the fiscal year close. [constraint; valid 2026-03-19 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-19]
- The event bus deploys on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-02-21 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-21]
